exact_prompt:
Create a flat 2D research illustration from the attached single product photograph. Preserve the pictured golden-brown bear's exact identity, outfit, visible angle and pose; translate only the rendering into crisp, uniform flat color shapes.
Identity and geometry: a very large rounded furry head, dark-brown round ears, golden-brown broad forehead with a central downward tuft, a small pale-cream double-lobed heart-shaped face mask, rounded peach cheek lobes, tiny dark-red oval nose and a very short shallow closed smile. Small widely spaced dark oval eyes have warm brown side arcs and tiny pale clover-like highlights. Keep the original head tilt toward the viewer's left and the original head-to-body ratio. The small body has short arms spread with unequal bends and short separated legs.
Clothes: cream and pale-yellow striped short-sleeve shirt, red neckerchief with the two visible tail tips pointing to the viewer's right, dark-indigo bib shorts with two shoulder straps, two tan round buttons, thin ochre seam lines and turned-up hems. Exposed paws and feet remain golden brown. Keep all these colored areas in their photographed positions.
Flat-color constraint: every single contiguous color region must have a single solid uniform RGB fill, including the entire golden-brown head, cream mask, each cheek, the red scarf and both dark-indigo trouser legs. No lighter centers, darker edges, gradients, shading, texture, noise, brush grain, paper grain, fabric weave or lighting. Only the eye highlights, short tuft lines, seam lines and necessary solid-color feature boundaries interrupt fills. Use a restrained slightly irregular outer contour to indicate fur, not individual hairs. This is an unshaded vector-style color diagram, not a dimensional plush rendering.
Composition: preserve the original leaning full-body pose on a completely uniform pure-white background with margins on all sides. Remove the landscape, grass, loose candy, cast shadows, copyright marks and embroidered lettering. Do not add accessories, a hanging ring, hidden back details, text or other characters. Do not change the subject or simplify its face into a different generic bear.
